turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
Hello, I'm sorry your print has not arrived yet. I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I'm sorry you feel this way, and I understand your frustration with the delivery. Since you have said you will take this to the consumer authority, your bank and a public review, I have passed your case to a colleague who will take over from here.

input.summary: Customer says their print has not arrived and wants help with the delivery. They have not yet given an order number or email, so they are not verified.
